Thought: The carbon NMR spectra provide the chemical shifts of the carbons in the molecule. Aromatic carbons typically have chemical shifts in the range of approximately 110-160 ppm. I will count the number of chemical shifts within this range to determine the number of aromatic carbons.

The chemical shifts provided are: 196.40, 137.56, 137.56, 131.90, 131.90, 130.00, 130.00, 130.00, 130.00, 128.40, 128.40, 128.40, 128.40.

The shifts within the aromatic range (110-160 ppm) are: 137.56, 137.56, 131.90, 131.90, 130.00, 130.00, 130.00, 130.00, 128.40, 128.40, 128.40, 128.40.

Counting these, there are 12 aromatic carbons.
